articles.title: UBS GWM: Bullish on fixed income as disinflationary pressures build

On Japan, he flags yen weakness despite undervaluation, but holds equities unhedged given the natural offset between currency and exporter earnings.

articles.title: A striking immune cell pattern emerges around a person’s 100th birthday
articles.description: Single-cell immune profiling found that CD4 cytotoxic T lymphocytes become more abundant around age 100, showing stepwise differentiation and substantial clonal expansion. Ex vivo experiments also revealed cytokine plasticity within individual clones, supporting the hypothesis that these cells adapt to persistent antigens during healthy aging, although their direct role in longevity remains unproven.

articles.title: Gut bacteria may unlock a hidden benefit of vegetables
